info.title: Project Showcase API
info.description: API for developer project showcasing platform

get.description:
The Latest feed, newest first.

`before` is an opaque cursor from a previous response's `next_cursor`, not
an offset: the stream is append-only, so a row never crosses a page boundary
between requests.

The lead is only sent on the first page — it is the top of the feed, and
repeating it under every page of results would render it twice.
List all competitions the current user is assigned to review.
Get competition details with projects and reviewer's rankings.

put.description:
Replace the reviewer's ballot for a competition.

The payload is the ballot in full: projects left out are unranked, and an
empty list is a valid abstention.
Update the reviewer's status for a competition.

get.description:
Get project details for a reviewer.

Returns the project if the user is assigned as a reviewer to any
competition that contains this project. Returns 404 otherwise.
List all approved and pending tags (excludes rejected).

List tags grouped by category (excludes rejected tags).

If with_projects=true, only returns tags with at least one approved project.

post.description: Suggest a new tag (creates with status=pending, immediately usable).

get.description: List pending tags for review (admin only).

put.description: Reject a tag (admin only). Removes tag from all projects.

CompetitionStandingResponse.description:
Where a project stands. An empty `opportunities` means no competition is
accepting applications — not that the project is ineligible.
CompetitionStandingResponse.title: CompetitionStandingResponse

CompetitionSummary.description:
Enough of a competition to render and link to it without a second call.

`image_url` reads a field already loaded on the instance, so carrying it
costs no query — which is what lets the entry dialogs show a round as a row
with its image.
CompetitionSummary.title: CompetitionSummary

CropRect.description: A crop rectangle normalised 0-1 against the source image.
CropRect.title: CropRect

ListingImageMode.description:
How an article's listing image was decided.

A nullable ``listing_image`` cannot tell "not chosen yet" from "deliberately
removed", so removal would not survive the next save.
ListingImageMode.title: ListingImageMode

ArticleImageUploadRequest.description:
An article upload names only the file.

The article it belongs to is in the path, so there is no `source` /
`source_id` pair here that could disagree with which article the row is
stored against.
ArticleImageUploadRequest.title: ArticleImageUploadRequest

FeedEntryResponse.description:
One row of the feed.

Deliberately structured rather than pre-rendered: no display copy crosses
the wire, so the labels stay where the rest of the UI's wording lives.
FeedEntryResponse.title: FeedEntryResponse

FeedSupersededRef.description:
What the entry took the place of.

Carries the flag an article-led entry renders above its headline: a winner
write-up still reads as a competition winner, because that is what gives it
its context.
FeedSupersededRef.title: FeedSupersededRef

CompetitionEntryRequest.description:
Required: the endpoint never infers which competition to enter. Guessing
is what the publish side effect did, and is the bug this replaces.
CompetitionEntryRequest.title: CompetitionEntryRequest

ReviewCompetitionResponse.description: Competition that the current user is assigned to review.
ReviewCompetitionResponse.title: ReviewCompetitionResponse

ReviewCompetitionDetailResponse.description:
Competition detail split into the reviewer's ballot and what is left.

`ranked_projects` is in the reviewer's saved order; `pool_projects` is in an
order stable for this reviewer and uncorrelated with any other reviewer's.
The client renders both as given rather than deriving an order of its own.
ReviewCompetitionDetailResponse.title: ReviewCompetitionDetailResponse

ReviewProjectResponse.description: Project within a competition being reviewed, with ranking info.
ReviewProjectResponse.title: ReviewProjectResponse

RankingUpdateRequest.description: Request to update rankings for a competition.
RankingUpdateRequest.title: RankingUpdateRequest

StatusUpdateRequest.description: Request to update the reviewer's status for a competition.
StatusUpdateRequest.title: StatusUpdateRequest

ReviewProjectDetailResponse.description: Full project details for a reviewer.
ReviewProjectDetailResponse.title: ReviewProjectDetailResponse
